title: Elige el mundo visual de la portada
question: The roll assigned Línea 68. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Línea 68
options.lineage: Mexico 68 parallel-line identity and the CDMX Metro line diagram
options.thesis: The bid is one line with stations, Planos → Revisión → Catálogo → Generadores → OPUS; the same strokes that draw the plan become the rows of numbers.
materials: parallel offset strokes with rounded line bends
options.viewport: Huge headline top left over a bundle of four parallel lines that runs the full width and bends up the right edge; five numbered stations sit on it; Crear cuenta in rosa beside Entrar.
options.risk: Pastiche if the 68 striping is copied as costume; it has to stay ink-only, with one colour and a working station line.

raised.raise: Type as matter: the wordmark's strokes physically become the page's lines.
Charged emptiness: each section is one line in a large deliberate field, nothing filling the gaps.
Coordinates as wayfinding: every quantity is labelled by its eje coordinates, like an atlas index.
Each station carries a two-digit address, and keys 1–5 jump to it.

options.label: Hoja de generadores
options.lineage: The printed hoja de números generadores with croquis and firmas
options.thesis: The homepage is the deliverable itself: a generador sheet whose rows point back to eje and hoja.
options.viewport: Sheet header rule; headline; three real-looking generador rows (synthetic) with clave, eje, hoja and cantidad; Crear cuenta in the firmas strip.
options.risk: Familiar document-as-page trope; can read as a spreadsheet rather than a product.

options.label: Metro tiles
options.thesis: Giant lowercase cropped off the edge; flat tiles are the only doors.
options.viewport: Black ground, 'generadores de obra' cropped off the right edge, a row of tiles with Crear cuenta flooded in lime.
options.case: Holds clarity (type as interface, nothing extra) but loses identification: it says nothing about Mexican obra.
options.risk: Dated tech nostalgia; the lime tile fights the less-colour brand rule.

options.label: Alphabet storm
options.viewport: Words breaking into weather across white.
options.case: Fuses poorly: poetic, not a bid tool.
options.kept: Type as matter: the wordmark's strokes become the page's lines.

options.label: Ikebana ma
options.thesis: Emptiness made active by one line.
options.viewport: One branch in a quiet alcove.
options.case: Fuses poorly: serene, foreign to the audience.

options.label: Star atlas
options.thesis: Coordinates and magnitudes index the sky.
options.viewport: A chart plate with an index of named objects.
options.case: Fuses poorly: lovely notation, wrong subject.
options.kept: Coordinates as wayfinding for every quantity.
options.risk: Night-sky mood over a daylight office.

options.label: Teletext service
options.thesis: Every page has an address you key in.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A SaaS landing: headline and screenshot side by side, features below, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Headline left, app screenshot right, two buttons.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other construction-software site.
